intent: Shopping for a portable speaker for our balcony and every listing screams the same stuff: 40 watts, 360-degree sound, IPX7 waterproof, deep bass from a passive radiator, hi-res audio over Bluetooth. I got burned before by a speaker that distorted the moment I turned it up, so I flat out don't trust the boxes anymore. Which of these claims mean something physically real in a speaker this size, and which are marketing? And do owners who actually took theirs to the pool or beach back any of it up? Point me at a speaker whose claims actually hold.

intent_v1_legacy: I just moved into an apartment with a decent balcony and I'm determined to actually grow things this time instead of killing everything by August. But shopping for this stuff is a minefield of pots, soils, fertilizers, and grow lights all promising miracles, and I can't tell which claims are real plant science and which are marketing fluff. What do experienced indoor and balcony gardeners actually rate versus regret? I'd love to know which brands hold up, where the glowing product ratings don't match what people say in forums, and what you'd actually put in my cart.
